All right, then, do it. Use these marvelous powers of yours. Conduct this business of forging verses the way you'd manage a love affair. You meet by chance, feel a tingle, stick around, and bit by bit you get involved. Happiness thrives, then it’s endangered. First you're enraptured, then writhing in anguish. And before you know it, you've got a whole novel. And that’s how it’s done. So let’s do it. Let’s give the play that way! Plunge your hand into the fullness of life. We all of us live it, few of us know it; but it’s interesting wherever you grab it. Variety, color, confusion, error, and then a tantalizing soupcon of truth. That’s how the best beers are brewed, a brew that refreshes and makes you think, too. Ah, the best of youth will flock to your play, eager for any revelation. The sentimental will suck melancholy strength, and this and that and everyone will take from it what each has felt in his heart. Being young they're as ready to weep as to laugh; they still have ideals and delight in illusion. Adults you can never please, they've stopped growing, but youth will always be grateful for what you offer.
translation:
@@U00025@@
好吧，那就去做吧。使用你的这些奇妙的力量。以处理爱情的方式来处理锻造业务。你们偶然相遇，感到刺痛，坚持下去，一点一点地参与其中。幸福会蓬勃发展，然后就会受到威胁。首先你欣喜若狂，然后痛苦地翻滚。在你不知不觉中，你已经有了一本完整的小说。事情就是这样完成的。那么让我们开始吧。我们就这样演戏吧！将你的手投入到充实的生活中。我们所有人都生活在其中，但很少有人知道；但无论你在哪里抓住它，它都会很有趣。多样性、色彩、混乱、错误，然后是诱人的真理汤。这就是最好的啤酒的酿造方法，这种啤酒既能提神，又能引发思考。啊，最优秀的年轻人会涌向你的表演，渴望得到任何启示。多愁善感会吸收忧郁的力量，而这个、那个、每个人都会从中汲取每个人内心的感受。年轻的时候，他们既想哭，又想笑；他们仍然有理想，乐于幻想。你永远无法取悦成年人，他们已经停止成长，但年轻人永远会感激你所提供的一切。
